abilities.name: Twin Bolts
abilities.description: Paired bolts, aimed two ways: Focus fires a line 6 squares long, Spread fans a cone 2 squares out. Same damage either way — the mode is the spacing decision.

abilities.name: Skim
abilities.description: Glide up to 4 squares; the first enemy passed takes 12 damage. The dodge is also the poke — dodges Blast attacks aimed at your old square.

abilities.name: Slipstream
abilities.description: Ride the wind: Haste and Energized for a turn. Converts a quiet turn into position and ult tempo.

abilities.name: Kite Shot
abilities.description: A long shot that Slows for a turn. Opens the gap that Skim spends.

ultimate.name: Tempest Run
ultimate.description: A full-board damaging dash: every enemy passed takes 35 and is Slowed. Resolves in the Dash phase, so it also dodges the turn's Blast. (100 energy)
